pokemon_breeder_f.name: Woman
dialog: Welcome to Floaroma Town! Flowers, flowers, and then more flowers!
You ought to plant a few yourself. There's nothing like it.

school_kid_m.name: Schoolboy
dialog: Berries aren't only pretty. Pokémon eat them.
Give one to a Pokémon to hold and it eats it in battle, right when it needs it.

beauty.name: Beauty
dialog: I do love it here. The air itself seems to lift you up.
You've come to rest your heart a little too, haven't you?

lass_west.name: Lass
dialog: With flowers on every side I can't stay in a bad mood, however hard I try.

lass_east.name: Lass
dialog: Do you know the Gracidea flower? It has grown here for longer than anyone remembers.
People give a bunch of them when they want to say thank you.

camper.name: Camper
dialog: I followed a sweet smell all the way here. Honey, that's what it is!
...What am I, a Pokémon? Mmm. Honey.

npcs.name: Stall keeper
dialog: Stall keeper: It's the Blossom Days! Every petal in town is out to see you.
